findings.title: Discount formula returns price * percent instead of discounted price
findings.explanation: New code computes `amount * rate` where rate is raw percent (e.g. 10). Correct is amount*(1-pct/100). So 10% off $100 returns 1000.0 instead of $90.00. Breaks all pricing.

evidence.why: New return multiplies price by raw percent instead of (1-pct/100).

findings.suggestion: Restore Decimal logic: amount=to_money(price); pct=Decimal(str(percent)); validate 0-100; return quantize(amount*(1-pct/100)).

findings.title: Float conversion breaks Decimal money handling and cent rounding
findings.explanation: Switch from to_money/Decimal/quantize to float changes return type from Decimal to float, introduces binary floating-point error for money, and stops rounding to cents, violating docstring Returns Discounted amount as Decimal, rounded to cents.

evidence.why: float() replaces to_money/Decimal/quantize, changing return type and precision.

findings.suggestion: Keep Decimal arithmetic and quantize to cents; avoid float for money.

findings.title: Removed 0-100 percent range validation allows invalid discounts
findings.explanation: Removed pct<0 or pct>100 ValueError allows negative or >100% discounts, producing negative totals or price increases with no error.

evidence.why: Replacement deletes pct <0 or >100 ValueError with no equivalent check.

findings.suggestion: Re-add range check raising ValueError for percent outside 0-100.
